decisions.instruction: Select the storage zone that matches the shipment's storage_requirement.
Does this shipment need temperature-controlled storage? Chilled and frozen shipments do; ambient shipments do not.
Choose the priority using hours_until_dispatch and the exact thresholds in the levels.

levels.criterion: More than 24 hours remain until dispatch.
More than 6 hours and at most 24 hours remain until dispatch.
At most 6 hours remain until dispatch.
